findings.title: `queued` is shared across every AssignmentSource created by a process
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when the class body is imported, not when an `AssignmentSource` instance is created. Consequently every source created by a worker process receives and serializes the same startup-time `queued` value, rather than the time that inbound assignment was queued. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so the timestamp is generated per instance.
